## Assistant

We're building Kairo's core learning experience—Practice Mode and CBT Exam Mode as two modes of a unified system. The Design System is locked; we use only approved tokens/components.

We built a complete connected prototype in `ui_kits/kairo-learning/` covering both modes end-to-end: subject/topic/subtopic/difficulty selection → timed practice sessions with per-question explanation blocks, a calm Kai tutor panel (explain again / another example / simplify / teach from scratch / formula / memory trick), and confidence ratings → end-of-session summaries with accuracy, time per question, strongest/weakest subject, and Kairo Score. CBT Exam Mode includes realistic JAMB simulation: exam setup, instructions, timed countdown with 5-minute warning, question palette modal (per-subject grids, flag toggle, prev/next navigation), calculator modal, and auto-submit at 0:00.

Motion is subtle (fades/slides only, no celebration animations). Questions display cleanly with progress, subject badge, bookmark, report—one at a time, maximum whitespace. Explanations show why the answer is correct, why others are wrong, common mistakes, key concepts, exam tips.

Recent fix corrected stale state carry-over in PracticeQuestion by adding a stable key per question—now each question remounts fresh instead of reusing React component state across answers.

Current state: full prototype compiles clean, no console errors, all navigation wired (mode select → setup screens → question flow → summary screens → review allowed). Both modes integrated into LearningApp shell.

Open next steps: build Review/Insights section (performance tracking, topic strengths/gaps, recommended next sessions), then wire into main app shell with the onboarding flow.

Key files: ui_kits/kairo-learning/[data.js, Shared.jsx, PracticeSetup.jsx, PracticeQuestion.jsx, PracticeSummary.jsx, CbtSetup.jsx, CbtExam.jsx, CbtSummary.jsx, LearningApp.jsx, index.html].

## User

Refactor the existing Practice experience instead of redesigning it.

Do NOT regenerate the entire flow.

Keep the Design System, spacing, typography, components, interactions and visual language exactly as they are.

Only make the following architectural improvements.

----------------------------------------------------
1. PRACTICE ENTRY FLOW
----------------------------------------------------

The Practice experience should begin from every relevant entry point on the Home Dashboard.

Supported entry points:

• Subject Practice
• Topic Practice
• Mixed Practice
• Weak Practice
• Suggested Session / Today's Mission

Each entry point should intelligently determine whether a Subject Selection screen is needed.

Rules:

• Subject Practice
→ opens Subject Selection first.

• Topic Practice
→ opens Subject Selection
→ then Topic Selection.

• Mixed Practice
→ skips Subject Selection entirely
→ goes directly to Session Setup.

• Weak Practice
→ automatically loads weak topics
→ skips Subject Selection.

• Suggested Session
→ opens directly into the prepared session.

The transition between these screens should feel seamless.

----------------------------------------------------
2. SUBJECT SELECTION
----------------------------------------------------

Design a dedicated Subject Selection screen.

Requirements:

• Search bar
• Complete UTME subject list
• Recent subjects section
• Favourite subjects (if available)
• Selected subject highlighted
• Continue button

Do not use cards with random colours.

Use Kairo's existing minimal visual language.

----------------------------------------------------
3. QUESTION INTERFACE
----------------------------------------------------

Improve the Question interface.

Top right should contain:

Bookmark icon

Calculator icon

Overflow (•••)

NOT just Bookmark.

Keep the interface extremely clean.

----------------------------------------------------
4. MINI CALCULATOR
----------------------------------------------------

When Calculator is tapped:

Do NOT navigate away.

Instead reveal a compact calculator as a bottom sheet or floating overlay.

The student must still be able to see the current question while calculating.

The calculator should never occupy the full screen.

Required functions:

✓ + − × ÷

✓ %

✓ Decimal point

✓ Square root (√)

✓ Backspace

✓ Clear

✓ Equals

Numbers should automatically insert commas where appropriate as the user types.

Examples:

1000
becomes

1,000

1000000
becomes

1,000,000

The overlay should dismiss smoothly.

----------------------------------------------------
5. OVERFLOW MENU
----------------------------------------------------

Move secondary actions into the overflow menu (•••).

Include:

• Flag Question
• Report Question
• Hide Elimination Marks
• Question Feedback

Do not clutter the main toolbar.

----------------------------------------------------
6. QUESTION EXPERIENCE
----------------------------------------------------

Preserve the existing interaction but improve polish.

The flow should remain:

Question

↓

Answer

↓

Immediate feedback

↓

Explanation

↓

Kai assistance (optional)

↓

Confidence rating (when applicable)

↓

Next Question

This should feel like one continuous learning journey.

Never like separate disconnected pages.

----------------------------------------------------
7. SESSION SUMMARY
----------------------------------------------------

Retain the Session Summary.

Improve recommendations.

Instead of generic recommendations, recommend:

Continue Weak Areas

Retry Incorrect Questions

Challenge Yourself

Take a CBT Simulation

Review Explanations

The recommendations should feel intelligent and personalised.

----------------------------------------------------
8. EXPERIENCE GOAL
----------------------------------------------------

Every interaction should reinforce Kairo's philosophy:

Students learn through questions.

This should never resemble a traditional CBT app.

It should feel calm,
premium,
AI-guided,
adaptive,
and intentionally designed around learning rather than testing.

----------------------------------------------------
IMPORTANT
----------------------------------------------------

This is a refactor of the existing Practice module.

Do NOT redesign unrelated screens.

Do NOT change the Design System.

Do NOT modify colours, typography, spacing or components.

Only improve the flow, interactions and information architecture while keeping the current visual identity.
